verdict.rationale: Babylon.js ships an Inspector for visual scene debugging/editing and a Node Material Editor for shader authoring, but these are auxiliary tools layered on a code-first workflow, not a full viewport+inspector+prefab system for composing levels as the primary build method. Missing for 10: a unified visual editor with scene composition/prefab workflow, evidence that artists build levels primarily via UI rather than code, and independent corroboration of using Inspector/NME as a primary level-building tool.
